statement: Written before any model in this study was fitted to DepMap data.

data.features: 24Q4 expression, log2(TPM+1); the 50 genes with the largest |Pearson r| with the target in the CONTEXT lines only (never the test lines); the target gene itself excluded
data.prospective: 26Q3 Humagne-CD (Cas12) gene effects of models first screened after 24Q4 (same set as agentic-ai-for-science amendment1); features from 26Q3 expression (default entry per model)

methods.mean: predict the context mean (reference for R^2)

metric: Pearson r between predicted and measured gene effect on the test lines, per target gene (averaged over repeats); secondary: out-of-sample R^2 vs the context mean

experiments.E1_curve: k in [16, 64, 256, 626] context lines drawn at random from discovery (3 repeats for k<626, seeds 0..2); test on all holdout lines
experiments.E2_lineage: for each lineage in ['Lung', 'Lymphoid', 'CNS/Brain', 'Skin', 'Esophagus/Stomach']: context = discovery lines of OTHER lineages + k in [0, 8] discovery lines of the lineage (3 repeats for k>0); test = that lineage's holdout lines
experiments.E3_prospective: context = all 1043 24Q4 Avana lines; test = 26Q3 new Cas12 lines, only for targets whose Avana-vs-Cas12 gene effects correlate r >= 0.5 across models screened in both libraries (decided from overlap lines, not the test lines)

hypotheses.H1 (primary): Few-shot advantage: at k = 16 and k = 64, mean over the 20 primary targets of r(TabPFN) - r(baseline) > 0 for baseline = ridge and = random forest. 4 comparisons; each tested with a gene-level bootstrap 98.75% interval (Bonferroni over the 4); supported if the interval excludes 0.
hypotheses.H2: At k = 626 (all discovery lines), TabPFN vs ridge and vs random forest: two-sided, reported with 95% intervals.
hypotheses.H3: Adapting to a cancer type: the gain from 0 to 8 in-lineage examples (mean over lineages and targets) is larger for TabPFN than for ridge. Secondary; 95% interval.
hypotheses.H4: Prospective: on new Cas12 lines, TabPFN vs ridge and vs random forest over eligible targets; two-sided, 95% intervals; reported whatever the number of eligible targets.

predictions.H1: TabPFN ahead at k = 16 and 64 (its prior acts as regularisation when data are scarce).
predictions.H2: Close to random forest at k = 626.
predictions.H4: Same ordering as H2, with lower correlations overall (new lines, new CRISPR system).
